																																																	local tbl37 = {}
																																																	local tbl38 = nil
																																																	local tbl39 = nil

																																																	_snapshotSky = function(arg)
																																																		local sky = arg:FindFirstChildOfClass("Sky")

																																																		if sky then
																																																			tbl38 = {
																																																				SkyboxBk = sky.SkyboxBk,
																																																				SkyboxDn = sky.SkyboxDn,
																																																				SkyboxFt = sky.SkyboxFt,
																																																				SkyboxLf = sky.SkyboxLf,
																																																				SkyboxRt = sky.SkyboxRt,
																																																				SkyboxUp = sky.SkyboxUp,
																																																				StarCount = sky.StarCount,
																																																				SunAngularSize = sky.SunAngularSize,
																																																				MoonAngularSize = sky.MoonAngularSize,
																																																				CelestialBodiesShown = sky.CelestialBodiesShown,
																																																				Name = sky.Name,
																																																			}
																																																		else
																																																			tbl38 = nil
																																																		end
																																																	end

																																																	_snapshotAtmosphere = function(arg)
																																																		local atmosphere = arg:FindFirstChildOfClass("Atmosphere")

																																																		if atmosphere then
																																																			tbl39 = {
																																																				Density = atmosphere.Density,
																																																				Offset = atmosphere.Offset,
																																																				Haze = atmosphere.Haze,
																																																				Glare = atmosphere.Glare,
																																																				Color = atmosphere.Color,
																																																				Decay = atmosphere.Decay,
																																																			}
																																																		else
																																																			tbl39 = {
																																																				Density = 0.22,
																																																				Offset = 0.15,
																																																				Haze = 0.8,
																																																				Glare = 0.15,
																																																				Color = Color3.fromRGB(200, 210, 255),
																																																				Decay = Color3.fromRGB(100, 110, 130),
																																																			}
																																																		end
																																																	end

																																																	_saveOriginal = function()
																																																		if flag43 then
																																																			return
																																																		end
																																																		flag43 = true
																																																		local Lighting = game:GetService("Lighting")

																																																		tbl37 = {
																																																			Brightness = Lighting.Brightness,
																																																			ColorShift_Bottom = Lighting.ColorShift_Bottom,
																																																			ColorShift_Top = Lighting.ColorShift_Top,
																																																			OutdoorAmbient = Lighting.OutdoorAmbient,
																																																			ClockTime = Lighting.ClockTime,
																																																			FogColor = Lighting.FogColor,
																																																			FogEnd = Lighting.FogEnd,
																																																			FogStart = Lighting.FogStart,
																																																			ExposureCompensation = Lighting.ExposureCompensation,
																																																			ShadowSoftness = Lighting.ShadowSoftness,
																																																			Ambient = Lighting.Ambient,
																																																		}

																																																		_snapshotSky(Lighting)
																																																		_snapshotAtmosphere(Lighting)
																																																	end

																																																	_lerpNum = function(arg, arg2, arg3)
																																																		return arg + (arg2 - arg) * arg3
																																																	end

																																																	_lerpColor = function(arg, arg2, arg3)
																																																		local clamp = math.clamp
																																																		local n34 = arg.B + (arg2.B - arg.B) * arg3
																																																		return Color3.new(math.clamp(arg.R + (arg2.R - arg.R) * arg3, 0, 1), math.clamp(arg.G + (arg2.G - arg.G) * arg3, 0, 1), clamp(n34, 0, 1))
																																																	end

																																																	_destroyShaderInstances = function()
																																																		for _, v75 in pairs(tbl34) do
																																																			pcall(function()
																																																				v75:Destroy()
																																																			end)
																																																		end

																																																		tbl34 = {}
																																																	end

																																																	_restoreAll = function()
																																																		local Lighting = game:GetService("Lighting")

																																																		for k, v75 in pairs(tbl37) do
																																																			pcall(function()
																																																				Lighting[k] = v75
																																																			end)
																																																		end

																																																		if tbl39 then
																																																			local atmosphere = Lighting:FindFirstChildOfClass("Atmosphere")

																																																			if atmosphere then
																																																				pcall(function()
																																																					atmosphere.Density = tbl39.Density
																																																					atmosphere.Offset = tbl39.Offset
																																																					atmosphere.Haze = tbl39.Haze
																																																					atmosphere.Glare = tbl39.Glare
																																																					atmosphere.Color = tbl39.Color
																																																					atmosphere.Decay = tbl39.Decay
																																																				end)
																																																			end
																																																		end

																																																		if tbl38 then
																																																			local sky = Lighting:FindFirstChildOfClass("Sky")
																																																			local sky2 = sky or Instance.new("Sky")
																																																			sky2.Name = tbl38.Name
																																																			sky2.SkyboxBk = tbl38.SkyboxBk
																																																			sky2.SkyboxDn = tbl38.SkyboxDn
																																																			sky2.SkyboxFt = tbl38.SkyboxFt
																																																			sky2.SkyboxLf = tbl38.SkyboxLf
																																																			sky2.SkyboxRt = tbl38.SkyboxRt
																																																			sky2.SkyboxUp = tbl38.SkyboxUp
																																																			sky2.StarCount = tbl38.StarCount
																																																			sky2.SunAngularSize = tbl38.SunAngularSize
																																																			sky2.MoonAngularSize = tbl38.MoonAngularSize
																																																			sky2.CelestialBodiesShown = tbl38.CelestialBodiesShown

																																																			if not sky then
																																																				sky2.Parent = Lighting
																																																			end
																																																		end
																																																	end

																																																	_applyRedShader = function(arg)
																																																		local n34 = arg / 10
																																																		local Lighting = game:GetService("Lighting")
																																																		local lighting = tbl35.Lighting
																																																		local v75 = tbl37
																																																		Lighting.Brightness = _lerpNum(v75.Brightness or 2, lighting.Brightness, n34)
																																																		Lighting.ColorShift_Bottom = _lerpColor(v75.ColorShift_Bottom or Color3.new(0, 0, 0), lighting.ColorShift_Bottom, n34)
																																																		Lighting.ColorShift_Top = _lerpColor(v75.ColorShift_Top or Color3.new(1, 1, 1), lighting.ColorShift_Top, n34)
																																																		Lighting.OutdoorAmbient = _lerpColor(v75.OutdoorAmbient or Color3.fromRGB(128, 128, 128), lighting.OutdoorAmbient, n34)
																																																		Lighting.ClockTime = _lerpNum(v75.ClockTime or 12, lighting.ClockTime, n34)
																																																		Lighting.FogColor = _lerpColor(v75.FogColor or Color3.fromRGB(192, 192, 192), lighting.FogColor, n34)
																																																		Lighting.FogEnd = _lerpNum(v75.FogEnd or 100000, lighting.FogEnd, n34)
																																																		Lighting.FogStart = _lerpNum(v75.FogStart or 0, lighting.FogStart, n34)
																																																		Lighting.ExposureCompensation = _lerpNum(v75.ExposureCompensation or 0, lighting.ExposureCompensation, n34)
																																																		Lighting.ShadowSoftness = _lerpNum(v75.ShadowSoftness or 0.5, lighting.ShadowSoftness, n34)
																																																		Lighting.Ambient = _lerpColor(v75.Ambient or Color3.new(0, 0, 0), lighting.Ambient, n34)

																																																		for _, v76 in pairs(tbl34) do
																																																			if v76:IsA("BloomEffect") then
																																																				v76.Intensity = _lerpNum(0, tbl35.Bloom.Intensity, n34)
																																																				v76.Size = _lerpNum(0, tbl35.Bloom.Size, n34)
																																																				v76.Threshold = tbl35.Bloom.Threshold
																																																			elseif v76:IsA("BlurEffect") then
																																																				v76.Size = _lerpNum(0, tbl35.Blur.Size, n34)
																																																			elseif v76:IsA("ColorCorrectionEffect") then
																																																				v76.Saturation = _lerpNum(0, tbl35.ColorCorrection.Saturation, n34)
																																																				local tintColor = tbl35.ColorCorrection.TintColor
																																																				v76.TintColor = _lerpColor(Color3.new(1, 1, 1), tintColor, n34)
																																																			elseif v76:IsA("SunRaysEffect") then
																																																				v76.Intensity = _lerpNum(0, tbl35.SunRays.Intensity, n34)
																																																			end
																																																		end
																																																	end

																																																	_buildRedShaderInstances = function()
																																																		local Lighting = game:GetService("Lighting")
																																																		local sky = Instance.new("Sky")
																																																		sky.Name = "SavitarShaderSky"
																																																		sky.SkyboxUp = "rbxassetid://323493360"
																																																		sky.SkyboxLf = "rbxassetid://323494252"
																																																		sky.SkyboxBk = "rbxassetid://323494035"
																																																		sky.SkyboxFt = "rbxassetid://323494130"
																																																		sky.SkyboxDn = "rbxassetid://323494368"

																																																					v75 = nil

																																																						if child.Name == "Boat Spawner" and child:GetAttribute("_isBeachModel") then
																																																							local position = arg.cframe.Position
																																																							if (child:GetPivot().Position - position).Magnitude < 10 then
																																																								v75 = child
																																																								break
																																																							end
																																																						end
																																																					end
																																																				end

																																																				if not v75 then
																																																					continue
																																																				end
																																																				local boat = nil

																																																				pcall(function()
																																																					boat = v75.Vehicle.Vehicle.Vehicle.boat
																																																				end)

																																																				if not boat then
																																																					continue
																																																				end
																																																				local v76 = boat
																																																				local position = arg.cframe.Position

																																																				if (v76:GetPivot().Position - position).Magnitude >= 50 then
																																																					local now2 = tick()

																																																					if now2 - n35 >= 5 then
																																																						v75 = nil
																																																						task.wait(5)
																																																						if not flag38 then
																																																							return
																																																						end
																																																						local v77 = _beachLoadModel(arg, arg2)
																																																						task.wait(2)
																																																						v75 = v77
																																																						n35 = now2
																																																					end
																																																				end
																																																			end
																																																		end)
																																																	end

																																																	_beachApplyBoatMass = function(arg)
																																																		task.defer(function()
																																																			for _, descendant in ipairs(arg:GetDescendants()) do
																																																				if descendant:IsA("BasePart") then
																																																					pcall(function()
																																																						local customPhysicalProperties = descendant.CustomPhysicalProperties
																																																						local density, friction, elasticity, frictionWeight, elasticityWeight

																																																						if customPhysicalProperties then
																																																							density = customPhysicalProperties.Density
																																																							friction = customPhysicalProperties.Friction
																																																							elasticity = customPhysicalProperties.Elasticity
																																																							frictionWeight = customPhysicalProperties.FrictionWeight
																																																							elasticityWeight = customPhysicalProperties.ElasticityWeight
																																																						else
																																																							frictionWeight = 1
																																																							elasticity = 0.5
																																																							density = 0.7
																																																							elasticityWeight = 1
																																																							friction = 0.3
																																																						end

																																																						descendant.CustomPhysicalProperties = PhysicalProperties.new(density / 3.2, friction, elasticity, frictionWeight, elasticityWeight)
																																																					end)
																																																				end
																																																			end
																																																		end)
																																																	end

																																																	_beachStartLuxuryBoatMonitor = function(arg, arg2, arg3)

																																																				local main = nil

																																																					main = v75:FindFirstChild("Main", true)
																																																				end

																																																				if not main then

																																																						n35 = now2
																																																					else
																																																						n35 = now2
																																																					end

																																																					continue

																																																				if (main.Position - arg.cframe.Position).Magnitude >= 140 then
																																																					local now2 = tick()

																																																						if not flag38 then
																																																							return
																																																						end

																																																						task.wait(2)

																																																						v75 = nil

																																																							v75 = v76
																																																							n35 = now2
																																																						else
																																																							n35 = now2
																																																						end
																																																					end
																																																				end
																																																			end

																																																			task.spawn(function()
																																																				local function fn44(arg)
																																																					if not arg then
																																																						return
																																																					end

																																																					pcall(function()
																																																						for _, descendant in ipairs(arg:GetDescendants()) do

																																																								descendant.CanCollide = false
																																																								descendant.CanTouch = false
																																																								descendant.CanQuery = false
																																																							end
																																																						end

																																																						if arg:IsA("BasePart") then
																																																							arg.Transparency = 1
																																																							arg.CanCollide = false
																																																							arg.CanTouch = false
																																																							arg.CanQuery = false
																																																						end
																																																					end)
																																																				end

																																																					local tbl42 = {

																																																						[478] = Vector3.new(-255.17525, 102.498024, -987.6846),
																																																					}

																																																					local function fn45(arg)
																																																						local children = arg:GetChildren()

																																																						for k, v75 in pairs(tbl42) do
																																																							local v76 = children[k]

																																																							if v76 then
																																																								local position = nil

																																																								pcall(function()
																																																									if v76:IsA("BasePart") then
																																																										position = v76.Position
																																																									elseif v76:IsA("Model") then
																																																										position = v76:GetPivot().Position
																																																									end
																																																								end)

																																																								if position and (position - v75).Magnitude < 30 then
																																																									fn44(v76)
																																																								else
																																																									fn44(v76)
																																																								end
																																																							end
																																																						end
																																																					end

																																																					for i = 1, 60 do
																																																						local flag45 = true

																																																						for _, child in ipairs(workspace:GetChildren()) do
																																																							if child:IsA("Model") and child.Name == "Model" then
																																																								if #child:GetChildren() >= 478 then
																																																									fn45(child)
																																																								else
																																																									flag45 = false
																																																								end
																																																							end
																																																						end

																																																						if not flag45 then

																																																						break

																																																					local tbl42 = {}
																																																					local tbl43 = {}

																																																					for i = 1, #tbl41 do
																																																						tbl43[i] = math.huge
																																																					end

																																																						if descendant:IsA("BasePart") then

																																																					result:Play(0, 1, 0.8 + math.random() * 0.4)
																																																				end
																																																			end
																																																		end

																																																		local n36 = 0.18 + arg3 % 7 * 0.015
																																																		local n37 = (arg3 * 1.37 + math.random() * 3.1415926535897931) % 6.2831853071795862
																																																		local connection6 = nil

																																																		connection6 = game:GetService("RunService").Heartbeat:Connect(function(deltaTime)
																																																			if not arg or not arg.Parent then
																																																				connection6:Disconnect()
																																																				return
																																																			end
																																																			n37 += n36 * deltaTime
																																																			local n38 = math.sin(n37 * 2.3) * 4
																																																			local n39 = position.X + math.cos(n37) * n35
																																																			local n40 = position.Z + math.sin(n37) * n35
																																																			local n41 = y + n38
																																																			local n42 = n37 + 0.05
																																																			local n43 = position.X + math.cos(n42) * n35
																																																			local n44 = position.Z + math.sin(n42) * n35
																																																			local vector = Vector3.new(n39, n41, n40)
																																																			local vector2 = Vector3.new(n43, n41, n44)
																																																			local n45 = CFrame.lookAt(vector, vector2) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, -0.20943951023931956)

																																																			pcall(function()
																																																				arg:PivotTo(n45)
																																																			end)
																																																		end)

																																																		table.insert(tbl35, connection6)
																																																	end)
																																																end

																																																_forestLoadModel = function(arg, arg2)
																																																	local ok, result = pcall(function()
																																																		return game:GetObjects("rbxassetid://" .. arg.assetId)
																																																	end)

																																																	if not ok or not result or not result[1] then
																																																		return
																																																	end
																																																	local v75 = result[1]
																																																	v75.Name = arg.name
																																																	v75.Parent = workspace
																																																	v75:SetAttribute("_isForestModel", true)
																																																	table.insert(tbl34, v75)

																																																	for _, descendant in ipairs(v75:GetDescendants()) do
																																																		if descendant:IsA("BasePart") then
																																																			descendant.Anchored = true
																																																		end
																																																	end

																																																	task.defer(function()
																																																		pcall(function()
																																																			v75:PivotTo(arg.cframe)
																																																		end)
																																																	end)

																																																	if arg.name == "SAVITAR" then
																																																		_forestStartHawkFlight(v75, arg.cframe, arg2)
																																																	end

																																																	return v75
																																																end

																																																_launchForest = function()
																																																	flag42 = true
																																																	tbl34 = {}

																																																	task.spawn(function()
																																																		for i, v75 in ipairs(tbl40) do
																																																			_forestLoadModel(v75, i)
																																																			task.wait(0.2)
																																																		end

																																																		_forestPostLoadCleanup()
																																																	end)

																																																	if flag43 then
																																																		fn41()
																																																		fn40()
																																																	end

																																																	if _riverSoundEnabled then
																																																		_riverStartProx()
																																																	end
																																																end

																																																_destroyForest = function()
																																																	flag42 = false
																																																	fn42()
																																																	fn43()
																																																	_riverDestroySound()

																																																	for _, v75 in pairs(tbl35) do
																																																		pcall(function()
																																																			v75:Disconnect()
																																																		end)
																																																	end

																																																	tbl35 = {}

																																																	for _, v75 in pairs(tbl34) do
																																																		pcall(function()
																																																			if v75 and v75.Parent then
																																																				v75:Destroy()
																																																			end
																																																		end)
																																																	end

																																																	tbl34 = {}
																																																end

																																																	if connection5 then
																																																		connection5:Disconnect()
																																																		connection5 = nil
																																																	end

																																																	for _, v75 in pairs(tbl36) do

																																																			v75:Destroy()
																																																		end)
																																																	end

																																																	tbl36 = {}
																																																	n33 = 0
																																																end

																																																	flag44 = false
																																																	flag37 = false

																																																		connection5:Disconnect()
																																																		connection5 = nil

																																																	fn43()

																																																	for k, v75 in pairs(tbl39) do
																																																		local sound2 = Instance.new("Sound")

																																																_forestRunFade = function(arg)
																																																	if connection5 then
																																																		connection5:Disconnect()
																																																		connection5 = nil
																																																	end

																																																	connection5 = game:GetService("RunService").Heartbeat:Connect(function(deltaTime)
																																																		if n33 < arg then
																																																			n33 = math.min(n33 + n34 * deltaTime, arg)
																																																		else
																																																			n33 = math.max(n33 - n34 * deltaTime, arg)
																																																		end

																																																		for k, v75 in pairs(tbl36) do
																																																			if tbl37[k] then
																																																				local volume = n33 * tbl38[k]
																																																				v75.Volume = volume

																																																				if volume > 0.001 and not v75.IsPlaying then
																																																					v75:Play()
																																																				elseif volume <= 0.001 and v75.IsPlaying then
																																																					v75:Pause()
																																																				end
																																																			end
																																																		end

																																																		if math.abs(n33 - arg) < 0.001 then
																																																			connection5:Disconnect()
																																																			connection5 = nil
																																																		end
																																																	end)
																																																end

																																																fn40 = function()
																																																	fn42()
																																																	flag44 = true
																																																	local Players4 = game:GetService("Players")

																																																	task.spawn(function()
																																																		local flag45 = false

																																																		local connection6 = Players4.LocalPlayer.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()
																																																			flag45 = false
																																																			flag37 = false
																																																			_forestRunFade(0)
																																																		end)

																																																		while flag44 do
																																																			local character5 = Players4.LocalPlayer.Character

																																																			if character5 then
																																																				character5 = character5:FindFirstChild("saviHRP") or character5:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
																																																			end

																																																			local flag46 = character5 ~= nil and _isInForestZone(character5.Position)

																																																			if flag46 ~= flag45 then
																																																				flag45 = flag46
																																																				flag37 = flag46

																																																				if flag46 then
																																																					_forestRunFade(1)
																																																				else
																																																					_forestRunFade(0)
																																																				end
																																																			end

																																																			task.wait(0.5)
																																																		end

																																																		connection6:Disconnect()
																																																	end)
																																																end

																																																			end

																																																			local character5 = Players4.LocalPlayer.Character

																																																			if character5 then
																																																				character5 = character5:FindFirstChild("saviHRP") or character5:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
																																																			end

																																																			local v75 = character5 and _riverSoundSelected and _isInForestZone(character5.Position)
																																																			local volume = 0

																																																			if v75 then
																																																				local clamp = math.clamp
																																																				local v76 = RIVER_MIN_DIST
																																																				local n35 = _distToRiverLine(character5.Position) - v76
																																																				local v77 = _riverSoundMaxVol
																																																				volume = (1 - clamp(n35 / (RIVER_MAX_DIST - RIVER_MIN_DIST), 0, 1)) * v77
																																																			end

																																																			if _riverSoundObj then
																																																				_riverSoundObj.Volume = volume

																																																				if volume > 0.001 and not _riverSoundObj.IsPlaying then
																																																					_riverSoundObj:Play()
																																																				elseif volume <= 0.001 and _riverSoundObj.IsPlaying then
																																																					_riverSoundObj:Pause()
																																																				end
																																																			end

																																																			task.wait(0.1)
																																																		end

																																																		connection6:Disconnect()
																																																	end)

																																																									at_rndInBounds = function()
																																																										local boundMin = tbl41.boundMin
																																																										local boundMax = tbl41.boundMax
																																																										local n36 = boundMax.X - boundMin.X
																																																										local n37 = boundMin.X + math.random() * n36
																																																										local n38 = boundMax.Y - boundMin.Y
																																																										local n39 = boundMin.Y + math.random() * n38
																																																										local z = boundMin.Z
																																																										local n40 = boundMax.Z - boundMin.Z
																																																										return vector(n37, n39, z + math.random() * n40)
																																																									end

																																																										local boundMin = tbl41.boundMin
																																																										local boundMax = tbl41.boundMax
																																																										return arg.X >= boundMin.X and arg.X <= boundMax.X and arg.Y >= boundMin.Y and arg.Y <= boundMax.Y and arg.Z >= boundMin.Z and arg.Z <= boundMax.Z
																																																									end

																																																									at_generatePath = function(arg, arg2)

																																																											local n37 = i / n36

																																																											tbl45[i] = n38 * n38 * arg + 2 * n38 * n37 * v77 + n37 * n37 * arg2
																																																										end

																																																										return tbl45
																																																									end
																																																								end

																																																								at_placeModel = function(arg, name, arg2, arg3)
																																																									local ok, result = pcall(function()
																																																										return game:GetObjects("rbxassetid://" .. arg)
																																																									end)

																																																									if not ok or not result or #result == 0 then
																																																										return
																																																									end
																																																									local v77 = result[1]
																																																									v77.Name = name
																																																									v77.Parent = Workspace
																																																									table.insert(tbl44, v77)
																																																									local tbl45 = {}

																																																									for _, descendant in ipairs(v77:GetDescendants()) do
																																																										if descendant:IsA("BasePart") then
																																																											table.insert(tbl45, descendant)
																																																										end
																																																									end

																																																									if #tbl45 == 0 then
																																																										return
																																																									end
																																																									local huge = math.huge
																																																									local n36 = -math.huge
																																																									local huge2 = math.huge
																																																									local n37 = -math.huge
																																																									local huge3 = math.huge
																																																									local n38 = -math.huge

																																																									for _, v78 in ipairs(tbl45) do
																																																										local position = v78.CFrame.Position
																																																										local size = v78.Size
																																																										huge = math.min(huge, position.X - size.X / 2)
																																																										n36 = math.max(n36, position.X + size.X / 2)
																																																										huge2 = math.min(huge2, position.Y - size.Y / 2)
																																																										n37 = math.max(n37, position.Y + size.Y / 2)
																																																										huge3 = math.min(huge3, position.Z - size.Z / 2)
																																																										n38 = math.max(n38, position.Z + size.Z / 2)
																																																									end

																																																									local n39 = (arg2.X / (n36 - huge) + arg2.Y / (n37 - huge2) + arg2.Z / (n38 - huge3)) / 3

																																																									if math.abs(n39 - 1) > 0.001 then
																																																										v77:ScaleTo(n39)
																																																									end

																																																									doSmoothTP = function(arg, arg2)
																																																										local desync2 = getgenv()._DESYNC
																																																										local enabled = desync2 and desync2.enabled
																																																										local loc = enabled and desync2.loc or arg.CFrame
																																																										local cframe2 = CFrame.new(arg2 + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0), arg2 + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0) + loc.LookVector)
																																																										local v77 = fn46((loc.Position - arg2).Magnitude)
																																																										local now2 = tick()

																																																										if flag48 then
																																																											pcall(function()
																																																												RunService8:UnbindFromRenderStep("SmoothTP")
																																																											end)
																																																										end

																																																										RunService8:BindToRenderStep("SmoothTP", Enum.RenderPriority.Camera.Value - 1, function()
																																																											local n35 = math.min((tick() - now2) / v77, 1)
																																																											local v78 = math.sin(n35 * 1.5707963267948966)
																																																											local v79 = loc:Lerp(cframe2, v78)

																																																											if enabled then
																																																												desync2.loc = v79
																																																												desync2.isOffsetted = true
																																																											else
																																																												pcall(function()
																																																													arg.CFrame = v79
																																																													arg.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
																																																													arg.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
																																																												end)
																																																											end

																																																											if n35 >= 1 then
																																																												flag48 = false

																																																												pcall(function()
																																																													RunService8:UnbindFromRenderStep("SmoothTP")
																																																												end)
																																																											end
																																																										end)
																																																									end

																																																					_RSP_lookAt = function(arg, arg2)
																																																						local n35 = arg2 - arg
																																																						if n35.Magnitude < 0.001 then
																																																							return CFrame.new(arg)
																																																						end
																																																						local unit = n35.Unit
																																																						local v79 = unit:Cross(Vector3.new(0, 1, 0))

																																																						if v79.Magnitude < 0.001 then
																																																							v79 = unit:Cross(Vector3.new(0, 0, 1))
																																																						end

																																																						return CFrame.fromMatrix(arg, v79, v79:Cross(unit))
																																																					end

																																																					_RSP_findAimedTarget = function()
																																																						local currentCamera3 = v77.CurrentCamera
																																																						local mouseLocation = UserInputService3:GetMouseLocation()
																																																						local n35 = 150
																																																						local v78 = nil

																																																						for _, player in ipairs(Players4:GetPlayers()) do
																																																							if player ~= localPlayer7 then
																																																								if player.Character then
																																																									if not _RSP_isInSafeZone(player) then
																																																										local saviHRP3 = player.Character:FindFirstChild("saviHRP") or player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
																																																										local humanoid3 = player.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")

																																																										if saviHRP3 and humanoid3 then
																																																											if not (humanoid3.Health <= 0) then
																																																												local v79, v80 = currentCamera3:WorldToViewportPoint(saviHRP3.Position)

																																																												if v80 then
																																																													local v81 = math.sqrt((v79.X - mouseLocation.X) ^ 2 + (v79.Y - mouseLocation.Y) ^ 2)

																																																													if v81 < n35 then
																																																														n35 = v81
																																																														v78 = player
																																																													end
																																																												end
																																																											end
																																																										end
																																																									end
																																																								end
																																																							end
																																																						end

																																																						return v78
																																																					end

																																																						local huge = math.huge
																																																						local v78 = nil

																																																						for _, player in ipairs(Players4:GetPlayers()) do
																																																							if player ~= localPlayer7 then
																																																								if player.Character then

																																																												end

																																																										end
																																																									end
																																																								end
																																																							end

																																																							tbl44[v78] = true
																																																							_RSP_startQueue()
																																																						end
																																																					end

																																																						local n36 = arg2 - arg
																																																						if n36.Magnitude < 0.001 then
																																																							return CFrame.new(arg)
																																																						end
																																																						local unit = n36.Unit
																																																						local v79 = unit:Cross(Vector3.new(0, 1, 0))

																																																						if v79.Magnitude < 0.001 then
																																																							v79 = unit:Cross(Vector3.new(0, 0, 1))
																																																						end

																																																						return CFrame.fromMatrix(arg, v79, v79:Cross(unit))
																																																					end

																																																					_G._AG.startMonitor = function()

																																																													if not ag.inQueue[k] then

																																																														ag.processQueue()
																																																													end
																																																												end
																																																											end
																																																										end

																																																						local stickyPart = nil

																																																															actionWheel.RebuildLayout = function(arg)
																																																																for _, itemFrame in pairs(arg._itemFrames) do
																																																																	if itemFrame and itemFrame.Frame then
																																																																		itemFrame.Frame:Destroy()
																																																																	end
																																																																end

																																																																arg._itemFrames = {}
																																																																local radius = arg.Radius or 180
																																																																local n36 = math.clamp(radius / 180, 0.65, 1.55)
																																																																local v97 = math.round(170 * n36)
																																																																local v98 = math.round(184 * n36)
																																																																arg._hubDeadzone = math.round(v97 * 0.28)

																																																																if tbl47.HubFrame then
																																																																	tbl47.HubFrame.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(v97, v97)
																																																																end

																																																																if tbl47.HubOuterRing then
																																																																	tbl47.HubOuterRing.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(v98, v98)
																																																																end

																																																																if tbl47.CenterIcon and not arg._selectedIndex then
																																																																	local v99 = math.round(70 * n36)
																																																																	tbl47.CenterIcon.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(v99, v99)
																																																																end

																																																																if tbl47.CenterTitle and not arg._selectedIndex then
																																																																	tbl47.CenterTitle.Size = UDim2.new(0.92, 0, 0, math.round(26 * n36))
																																																																	tbl47.CenterTitle.TextSize = math.clamp(math.round(17 * n36), 11, 24)
																																																																end

																																																																local n37 = #arg.Actions
																																																																if n37 == 0 then
																																																																	return
																																																																end
																																																																local n38, n39, n40, n41

																																																																if n37 == 1 then
																																																																	radius = math.clamp(radius * 0.9, 140, 195)
																																																																	n38 = 13.5
																																																																	n39 = 132
																																																																	n40 = 24
																																																																	n41 = 52
																																																																elseif n37 == 2 then
																																																																	radius *= 0.94
																																																																	n38 = 12
																																																																	n39 = 112
																																																																	n40 = 22
																																																																	n41 = 44
																																																																elseif n37 == 3 then
																																																																	radius *= 0.97
																																																																	n38 = 11
																																																																	n39 = 100
																																																																	n40 = 20
																																																																	n41 = 40
																																																																elseif n37 == 4 then
																																																																	n38 = 10.5
																																																																	n39 = 90
																																																																	n40 = 19
																																																																	n41 = 36
																																																																elseif n37 <= 6 then
																																																																	n38 = 10
																																																																	n39 = 82
																																																																	n40 = 18
																																																																	n41 = 33
																																																																elseif n37 <= 8 then
																																																																	n38 = 9
																																																																	n39 = 76
																																																																	n40 = 17
																																																																	n41 = 30
																																																																elseif n37 <= 12 then
																																																																	radius *= 1 + (n37 - 8) * 0.035
																																																																	n38 = 8
																																																																	n39 = 66
																																																																	n40 = 15
																																																																	n41 = 26
																																																																else
																																																																	radius *= 1 + (n37 - 8) * 0.04
																																																																	n38 = 7.5
																																																																	n39 = 56
																																																																	n40 = 13
																																																																	n41 = 22
																																																																end

																																																																local v99 = math.round(n39 * n36)
																																																																local v100 = math.round(n41 * n36)
																																																																local textSize = math.round(n38 * n36 * 10) / 10
																																																																local n42 = math.clamp(math.round(n40 * n36), 8, 30)

																																																																for i, action in ipairs(arg.Actions) do
																																																																	local n43 = (i - 1) * 6.2831853071795862 / n37 - 1.5707963267948966
																																																																	local n44 = math.cos(n43) * radius
																																																																	local n45 = math.sin(n43) * radius
																																																																	local round = math.round
																																																																	local udim2 = UDim2.new(0.5, math.round(n44), 0.5, round(n45))
																																																																	local n46 = math.clamp(math.round(10 * n36), 6, 14)
																																																																	local round2 = math.round
																																																																	local udim22 = UDim2.new(0.5, math.round(n44 + math.cos(n43) * n46), 0.5, round2(n45 + math.sin(n43) * n46))

																																																																if not arg2 or not arg2.Title then
																																																																	return
																																																																end
																																																																arg2.Id = arg2.Id or arg2.Title

																																																																for i, action in ipairs(arg.Actions) do
																																																																	if action.Id == arg2.Id then
																																																																		arg.Actions[i] = arg2
																																																																		arg:RebuildLayout()
																																																																		return
																																																																	end
																																																																end

																																																																table.insert(arg.Actions, arg2)
																																																																arg:RebuildLayout()
																																																															end

																																																															actionWheel.RemoveAction = function(arg, arg2)
																																																																for i, action in ipairs(arg.Actions) do

																																																																		table.remove(arg.Actions, i)
																																																																		arg:RebuildLayout()
																																																																		return
																																																																	end
																																																																end

																																																															local function savitarGetActionWheelActions()
																																																																local tbl49 = {}
																																																																local tbl50 = {}
																																																																table.clear(savitarAvailableToggles)

																																																																if toggles then
																																																																	for k, toggle in pairs(toggles) do
																																																																		if toggle and toggle.Type == "Toggle" and toggle.Text and toggle.Text ~= "" and not tbl50[toggle.Text] then
																																																																			local str6 = tostring(k or "")
																																																																			local str7 = tostring(toggle.Text or "")
																																																																			local v83 = string.lower(str7)
																																																																			local pos = k == "ActionWheel" or k == "ActionWheelSound" or k == "ActionWheelBlur" or k == "EnableCommandPanel" or str7 == "Enable Command Panel" or v83:find("command panel")

																																																																			if tbl48[str7] or tbl48[str6] then
																																																																				pos = true
																																																																			end

																																																																			if v83:find("house") or v83:find("barrier") or v83:find("plot") or str6:find("House") or str6:find("Barrier") or str6:find("Plot") then
																																																																				pos = true
																																																																			end

																																																																			if v83:find("disable") or str6:find("Disable") then
																																																																				pos = true
																																																																			end

																																																																			if v83:find("aim") or v83:find("trigger") then
																																																																				pos = true
																																																																			end

																																																																			local flag51 = str6 == "TLAntiAntiKick" or str6 == "BlobmanAntiAntiKick" or str7 == "Anti \\" or str6 == "AntiKickHighlight" or str6 == "ProtectionGiveAntiKick"
																																																																			local flag52

																																																																			if flag51 then
																																																																				flag52 = flag51
																																																																			else
																																																																				flag52 = (v83:find("anti kick") or v83:find("anti%-kick") or str6:find("AntiKick")) and str6 ~= "DefAntiKick" and str7 ~= "Anti Kick"
																																																																			end

																																																																			if flag52 then
																																																																				pos = true
																																																																			end

																																																																			if v83:find("give anti") then
																																																																				pos = true
																																																																			end

																																																																			if v83:find("highlight") or str6:find("Highlight") or v83:find("cham") or v83:find("outline") then
																																																																				pos = true
																																																																			end

																																																																			if v83:find("friend") or str6:find("Friend") then
																																																																				pos = true
																																																																			end

																																																																			if v83:find("liquid") or v83:find("toy menu") then
																																																																				pos = true
																																																																			end

																																																																			if v83:find("rainbow") then
																																																																				pos = true
																																																																			end

																																																																			if v83:find("clouds") then
																																																																				pos = true
																																																																			end

																																																																			if v83 == "ragdoll target" or str7 == "Ragdoll Target" or str6 == "RagdollTarget" then
																																																																				pos = true
																																																																			end

																																																																			if v83 == "kick" or v83 == "bring kick" or v83 == "bring" or v83 == "kill" or v83 == "void" or v83 == "lock" or v83 == "gucci" or v83 == "remove gucci" or v83 == "holdable" or v83 == "remove holdable" or v83 == "invisibility" or v83 == "ibnsiiblity" or v83 == "remove invisibility" or v83 == "remove inv" or v83:find("invisibility") or v83 == "player icons" or v83:find("player icon") or str6:find("NameIcon") or str6:find("TLMethod_Bring") or str6:find("TLMethod_Remove Invisibility") then
																																																																				pos = true
																																																																			end

																																																																			if not pos then
																																																																				tbl50[str7] = true
																																																																				savitarAvailableToggles[str7] = toggle
																																																																				table.insert(tbl49, str7)
																																																																			end
																																																																		end
																																																																	end
																																																																end

																																																																table.sort(tbl49, function(arg, arg2)
																																																																	local n36 = tbl46[arg] or 999
																																																																	local n37 = tbl46[arg2] or 999
																																																																	if n36 ~= n37 then
																																																																		return n36 < n37
																																																																	end
																																																																	return arg < arg2
																																																																end)

																																																															local function savitarGetSmartToggleIcon(arg)
																																																																if tbl47[arg] then
																																																																	return tbl47[arg]
																																																																end
																																																																local v83 = string.lower(arg)
																																																																if v83:find("aim") or v83:find("silent") or v83:find("trigger") then
																																																																	return "crosshair"
																																																																end

																																																																if v83:find("esp") or v83:find("cham") or v83:find("glow") or v83:find("wall") then
																																																																	return "eye"
																																																																end

																																																																if v83:find("fly") or v83:find("speed") or v83:find("walk") or v83:find("run") then
																																																																	return "wind"
																																																																end

																																																																if v83:find("jump") or v83:find("hop") or v83:find("bhop") then
																																																																	return "chevrons-up"
																																																																end

																																																																if v83:find("shield") or v83:find("anti") or v83:find("god") or v83:find("def") or v83:find("ragdoll") or v83:find("grab") then
																																																																	return "shield-check"
																																																																end

																																																																if v83:find("desync") or v83:find("lag") or v83:find("packet") or v83:find("ping") then
																																																																	return "zap"
																																																																end

																																																																if v83:find("tp") or v83:find("teleport") or v83:find("warp") then
																																																																	return "navigation"
																																																																end

																																																																if v83:find("rejoin") or v83:find("hop") or v83:find("server") or v83:find("reset") then
																																																																	return "refresh-cw"
																																																																end

																																																																if v83:find("kill") or v83:find("hit") or v83:find("damage") or v83:find("void") then
																																																																	return "skull"
																																																																end

																																																																if v83:find("light") or v83:find("sun") or v83:find("bright") or v83:find("day") then
																																																																	return "sun"
																																																																end

																																																																if v83:find("spin") or v83:find("roll") or v83:find("fling") then
																																																																	return "rotate-cw"
																																																																end

																																																																if v83:find("sound") or v83:find("mute") or v83:find("music") or v83:find("audio") then
																																																																	return "volume-2"
																																																																end

																																																																if v83:find("noclip") then
																																																																	return "ghost"
																																																																end
																																																																return "circle-check"
																																																															end

																																																															getgenv()._SAVITAR_GET_SMART_TOGGLE_ICON = savitarGetSmartToggleIcon

																																																															local function fn59(arg)
																																																																local tbl49 = {}

																																																																for _, v83 in ipairs(arg) do
																																																																	tbl49[v83] = savitarGetSmartToggleIcon(v83)
																																																																end

																																																																return tbl49
																																																															end

																																																															local function fn60()
																																																																if not _G.ActionWheel then
																																																																	return
																																																																end
																																																																local tbl49 = {}

																																																																if options and options.ActionWheelSelectedActions and options.ActionWheelSelectedActions.Value then
																																																																	for k, v83 in pairs(options.ActionWheelSelectedActions.Value) do
																																																																		if v83 then
																																																																			table.insert(tbl49, k)
																																																																		end
																																																																	end
																																																																end

																																																																table.sort(tbl49, function(arg, arg2)
																																																																	local n36 = tbl46[arg] or 999
																																																																	local n37 = tbl46[arg2] or 999
																																																																	if n36 ~= n37 then
																																																																		return n36 < n37
																																																																	end
																																																																	return arg < arg2
																																																																end)

																																																																if #tbl49 == 0 then
																																																																	tbl49 = { "Ragdoll" }
																																																																end

																																																																_G.ActionWheel.Actions = {}

																																																																for _, v83 in ipairs(tbl49) do
