																																																											local function fn58(arg, arg2, arg3)
																																																												if not arg or arg == "" then
																																																													return ""
																																																												end

																																																												if not arg2 or arg2 == "" then
																																																													return arg
																																																												end
																																																												local v85 = commandPanel.Normalize(arg)
																																																												local match = commandPanel.Normalize(arg2):lower():match("^%s*(.-)%s*$")
																																																												if not match or match == "" then
																																																													return v85
																																																												end
																																																												local str6 = v85:lower()
																																																												local str7 = arg3 and "#ffffff" or "#f0c96a"
																																																												local pos, v86 = str6:find(match, 1, true)
																																																												if pos and v86 <= #v85 then
																																																													return v85:sub(1, pos - 1) .. "<font color=\"" .. str7 .. "\"><b>" .. v85:sub(pos, v86) .. "</b></font>" .. v85:sub(v86 + 1)
																																																												end
																																																												local tbl45 = {}
																																																												local n37 = #match
																																																												local n38 = 1

																																																												for i = 1, #v85 do
																																																													local str8 = v85:sub(i, i)

																																																													if n38 <= n37 and str8:lower() == match:sub(n38, n38) then
																																																														table.insert(tbl45, "<font color=\"" .. str7 .. "\"><b>" .. str8 .. "</b></font>")
																																																														n38 += 1
																																																													else
																																																														table.insert(tbl45, str8)
																																																													end
																																																												end

																																																												return table.concat(tbl45)
																																																											end

																																																											fn56 = function(arg, image)
																																																												if not arg or not image then
																																																													return
																																																												end

																																																												if arg:GetAttribute("BoundIcon") == image and arg.Image ~= "" then
																																																													return
																																																												end
																																																												arg:SetAttribute("BoundIcon", image)

																																																												pcall(function()
																																																													if type(image) == "string" and (image:find("rbxasset") or image:find("http")) then
																																																														arg.Image = image
																																																														arg.ImageRectOffset = Vector2.zero
																																																														arg.ImageRectSize = Vector2.zero
																																																													elseif lib and lib.GetCustomIcon then
																																																														local customIcon = lib:GetCustomIcon(image)

																																																														if customIcon and (customIcon.Url or customIcon[1]) then
																																																															arg.Image = customIcon.Url or customIcon[1] or ""
																																																															arg.ImageRectOffset = customIcon.ImageRectOffset or Vector2.zero
																																																															arg.ImageRectSize = customIcon.ImageRectSize or Vector2.zero
																																																														elseif lib.ApplyLucideIcon then
																																																															lib:ApplyLucideIcon(arg, image)
																																																														end
																																																													elseif lib and lib.ApplyLucideIcon then
																																																														lib:ApplyLucideIcon(arg, image)
																																																													end
																																																												end)
																																																											end

																																																													if not saviHRP3 then

																																																															end

																																																															if character8 then
																																																																cFrame = character8.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 0, 3)
																																																															end

																																																										values = options.ActionWheelSelectedActions.Values
																																																									else
																																																										values = nil

																																																										if getgenv()._SAVITAR_GET_ACTION_WHEEL_ACTIONS then
																																																											values = getgenv()._SAVITAR_GET_ACTION_WHEEL_ACTIONS()
																																																										end
																																																									end

																																																									if not values or #values == 0 then
																																																										values = { "Ragdoll", "Fly", "Anti Lag", "Noclip", "Anti Grab", "Third Person View" }

																																																									local function fn59(arg)
																																																										if not arg or arg == "" then
																																																											return nil
																																																										end

																																																										if getgenv()._SAVITAR_AVAILABLE_TOGGLES and getgenv()._SAVITAR_AVAILABLE_TOGGLES[arg] then
																																																											return getgenv()._SAVITAR_AVAILABLE_TOGGLES[arg]
																																																										end

																																																										if not toggles then
																																																											return nil
																																																										end

																																																										if arg == "Fly" and toggles.FlyToggle then
																																																											return toggles.FlyToggle
																																																										end

																																																										if arg == "Ragdoll" and (toggles.RagdollLoopToggle or toggles.DefAntiRagdoll) then
																																																											return toggles.RagdollLoopToggle or toggles.DefAntiRagdoll

																																																																				makeBarrier = function(size, arg, part0, arg2)
																																																																					local part2 = Instance.new("Part")
																																																																					part2.Size = size

																																																																					part2.Material = Enum.Material.Neon

																																																																					part2.CanCollide = true
																																																																					part2.CanTouch = true
																																																																					part2.CanQuery = false
																																																																					part2.Massless = true
																																																																					part2.CustomPhysicalProperties = PhysicalProperties.new(0, 0, 0, 0, 0)
																																																																					part2.Anchored = false
																																																																					part2.CastShadow = false
																																																																					table.insert(tbl48, part2)
																																																																					tbl49[part2] = {}

																																																																					part2.Touched:Connect(function(hit)
																																																																						if not hit or not hit:IsA("BasePart") then
																																																																							return
																																																																						end

																																																																						if character7 and hit:IsDescendantOf(character7) then
																																																																							return
																																																																						end

																																																																						if part0 and (hit == part0 or hit:IsDescendantOf(part0)) then
																																																																							return
																																																																						end

																																																																						if not tbl49[part2][hit] then
																																																																							tbl49[part2][hit] = true
																																																																							local noCollisionConstraint = Instance.new("NoCollisionConstraint")
																																																																							noCollisionConstraint.Part0 = part2
																																																																							noCollisionConstraint.Part1 = hit
																																																																							noCollisionConstraint.Parent = part2
																																																																						end
